title: Maidan WebSocket subscribe filter
description: Filter accepted by GET /ws/subscribe. The caller must hold the event:subscribe capability.

workspace_id.description: When set, enables auto-replay from maidan_events on bus lag.

channel_grants.description: Allow-list for channel-scoped events; required to receive private channel traffic.

kinds.description: EventKind filter. Current values are published in event-kinds.json; unknown kinds should be ignored by clients for forward compatibility.
